# Catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-catalog.js. Do not edit; run `npm run docs:catalog`. -->

Every profile, runtime, module and policy currently in the catalog. This file is
generated from the manifests — if it disagrees with them, it is stale, not wrong.

For a filtered view, ask the CLI instead:

```bash
node scripts/init-repo.js list-modules --runtime rust
node scripts/init-repo.js explain-stack --profile <name>
```

## Policies

| Policy | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ci` | Adds CI workflow and validation defaults. |
| `documentation-baseline` | Strikte Vorgaben für Code-Kommentare, API-Dokumentation und Architekturentscheidungen. |
| `game-fairness-baseline` | Server-autoritative Spielregeln: kein Vertrauen in Client-Eingaben, geheime Information nur über playerView, deterministische Moves. |
| `mirror-instructions` | Generates mirrored instruction files derived from AGENTS.md. |
| `performance-baseline` | Zwingende Performance-Vorgaben, Budgets und Anti-Pattern-Checks für Scaffold- und Refactoring-Prozesse. |
| `privacy-baseline` | Zwingende DSGVO-Vorgaben zur Vermeidung von Drittanbieter-Datentransfers (Fonts, CDNs, Tracking). |
| `realtime-authority-baseline` | Server-autoritative Echtzeit-Sessions: vertraute Rollen aus Tokens, validierte Events, serverseitiger Zufall, Reconnect-Resync. |
| `security-baseline` | Applies baseline secure defaults for configuration and review. |
| `tdd-baseline` | Zwingt Agenten zur Test-First-Methodik (Red-Green-Refactor) und definiert Coverage-Standards. |
